question: Can move-only Stockfish supervision improve a small classification specialist while retaining raw legality, compared with its base weights?
license: MIT declared by pinned upstream model card; private local research, no weight redistribution
source: exact retained 4MiB Lichess CC0 prefix acquired in v1; source bytes and provider metadata preserved
exclusions: All historical seed and v1/v2 games, source-before and setup-after board keys, duplicate new games/boards; all previous holdouts are spent and excluded

teacher.target: actual UCI bestmove at search completion; one legal move label only
teacher.score_capture: last individual score-bearing info event, retaining type, perspective and same-event bound flags; never use merged stale bounds as exact observations

selection.criterion: highest raw top1 teacher agreement; then highest raw legality; then earliest checkpoint including step0 base
selection.holdout: only evaluate base and selected checkpoint after selection is saved; do not evaluate rejected checkpoints on holdout

metrics: complete denominator including rejected adapter/model cases
evaluation.representation: source-verified fixed78 native FEN tokens; input includes no teacher answer or continuation
evaluation.uncertainty: descriptive pilot with one position per source game; no Elo, professional commentary, significance or sports-transfer claim

resource_policy.cpu: at most8 one-thread Stockfish workers concurrent with independent LapSim sweeps; reduce on memory pressure
resource_policy.gpu: serialize against large Qwen engineering review; CUDA model training after that model unloads
resource_policy.ram: check freeRAM before dispatch and preserve4GiB free headroom; do not change power/thermal controls
resource_policy.purpose: useful throughput; no artificial load target

failure_policy: unsupported FEN encodings, absent labels, transport/model errors remain failures in each full split denominator; never silently resample to hide them
promotion_policy: a selected checkpoint is an experimental candidate; even improved heldout move agreement does not satisfy the commentary gate or authorize automatic default replacement
ai_assistance: Codex-assisted experiment implementation; local model suggestions are unverified hypotheses until deterministic checks
